name: Pulse: Project Metrics
subtitle: Your projects, at a glance
promotionalText: A small home for your project numbers. Connect your sources, choose useful KPIs and keep them close in your Mac menu bar and desktop widgets.
description:
Your project numbers, in the Mac menu bar.

Pulse is a small native app for keeping an eye on the things you build. Connect an API, PostgreSQL or Supabase and choose the numbers that matter.

• Discover useful KPIs from supported database structures.
• Pick up to three headline numbers for each project.
• Expand a project for extra KPIs and compact breakdowns.
• Switch between 24 hours, 7 days, 30 days and lifetime where source history is available.
• Keep numbers on your desktop with Project and Overview widgets.
• Receive optional native notifications for new activity.
• Share headline summaries between Macs with optional private iCloud sync.

Credentials stay in Keychain. Connections are read-only. There is no Pulse account or Pulse-hosted backend.

Keep Pulse running and your Mac awake for fresh numbers. Widgets follow macOS refresh scheduling. Available metrics and history depend on your source.

Free and open source.
